title: Sliko
description:

Об игре

Sliko is a puzzle game inspired by Sokoban.

Slide cubes to their designated locations

Transparent cube, when you push it against a colored cube it will acquire color.

Minimalist game designed and created to deliver a pleasant and great gameplay experience.Features: • 30 hand-crafted levels with increasing complexity(Can you solve them all? )

• Originally composed Soundtracks

• Beautiful minimalist aesthetic

• Playable with mouse and keyboard.

• Isometric and perspective camera modes.

• Color palette change.

• Unlimited undo moves.
